title: How do you know that it's going to rain?
scene: 他问爸爸怎么预判下雨。

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: How do you know that it's going to rain?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Look up. The clouds are getting dark and heavy.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Why does the sky look like that?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: The clouds are full of water. When they get too heavy, down comes the rain.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: How do you know so many sky things?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: I watch the sky every day on my way to work.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: So the sky is like a giant puddle up there?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Sort of! Grab your coat, just in case.
